duplication_audit.novel_axis: full horizontal-visibility graph topology of four past-only scalar paths at two fixed context lengths
duplication_audit.distinction: P3 v29 uses ordinal words and a fixed metric-recurrence threshold; v36 uses all-threshold distance-filtration component mergers. Horizontal visibility instead connects time indices by an order-obstruction rule and encodes degree, edge-span, triangle, and temporal-asymmetry topology. P1 v13 is an endpoint-only event detector for a different problem; v37 computes full graphs for P3 multi-output regression and transfers no P1 score or threshold.

rejected_axes.natural_visibility_slope: not added because it would create a second graph family after seeing results

encoder.input: historical hs, tp, hmax, and wind-speed paths at fixed 20-minute subsampling from the past-only 48h context
encoder.graph_rule: i<j are adjacent iff every intermediate value is strictly below min(x_i,x_j); adjacent indices always connect

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Luque, Lacasa, Ballesteros, and Luque, Horizontal visibility graphs: Exact results for random time series, Physical Review E 80, 046103 (2009)
primary_sources.use: order-obstruction graph mechanism only; not performance evidence
